snippet.title: Desert Race Adventures Trailer  - Launch Announcement
snippet.description:
Desert Race Adventures is hitting the road November 18!

Set out on a race across Europe and Africa. Manage your team, vehicle and supplies strategically as you navigate the treacherous terrain. Each challenge on the road forces difficult decisions that impact your journey. Lead your pilot team to victory, and finish with a high score! Or try, fail, and try again…

Coming to Steam and Nintendo Switch!

Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/496170/Desert_Race_Adventures/

Developed by Firedrake Games 
Published by Black Smoke Studios

#DesertRaceAdventures #indiegame #pcgame
